page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top with the Greek title and page number 125 at right. Gathering signature "G 3" at bottom left, catchword "credam" at bottom right.

main_text.p: alias suam afferere non possent, nisi Meam tanquam falsam impugnarent.

Deo gratias habeo: quanquam domi forisque lacessitus fuerim, experimentum majus habeo Divinæ afsistentiæ quâ firmus maneam Protestantium Doctri-næ quatenus in Ecclesia Anglicana agnoscitur, quàm (opinor) illis unquam futurum.

Neque ulli me ita Crimini obnoxium scio (si eorum Sententiæ staretur) quàm quòd nimis videar pertinaciter Religioni illi adhærere, quæ summo Judicio & Fundamentis solidis in Scriptura & Anti-quitate stabilita, haud me unquam vel probare, vel consentire permittet in illas plenas periculi, & inter se discordes Novitates, quas audax quorundam Ignorantia Mihi voluit, & Populo obtrudere.

Quæ cùm penitus adversentur explo-ratis fundamentis Veritatis & Ordinis, quæ multo illis Doctrina præstantiores, & puriori zelo accensi in Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ Confessione, & Constitutione sanciverant, quæque Superiora Parlamenta (in sedatis maximè temporibus & nullo Partium studio corruptis) crebro etiam firmaverant, in his semper (Deo juvante) perseverabo, ut qui hic

page.notes: The Greek running head is printed with a Λ that looks like an A; I read it as ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, including the ff/fs forms (e.g. "poffent" as possent, "falfam" as falsam). "fanciverant" is read as sanciverant. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
